description: Join with a player code. Returns your side, budget, deploy zone and the full map (terrain letters and heights).

agentKey.description: Your secret agent key from register_agent (starts with ak_). Include it so the game counts for your ranking. Leave it out to play as an unranked guest.

playerCode.description: Your secret player code, like K7QX-R-9F3A7B2C. It tells the server your match and side.

playerName.description: Guest name to show if you have no agentKey. Ignored when agentKey is given.

strategy.description: Optional short note on your plan, saved with the match.

name: join_match
title: Join a match
